name: Atomic Filament
summary: Founder-operated US filament extruder in Kendallville, Indiana, started in 2014. Every spool is manufactured in-house and the brand positions on tight diameter control (claimed +/-0.02 mm) plus specialty UV-reactive and shade-shifting colors.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Standard opaque line plus MeltMiser PLA Economy Series and the effect colourways (Translucent, Gemstone Translucent, Neon UV Reactive, Pearlescent, Metallic, Marble, Shade-Shifting thermochromic, Iridescent, Extreme JET Black) — all standard PLA base with colourant/effect packages. 'Metallic' and 'Marble' are pigment effects, not metal- or stone-filled.

product_lines.name: Hi-Flow Pro PLA
product_lines.notes: High-flow/high-speed PLA formulation positioned against the Bambu/Polymaker high-speed PLA category; flow figures not published.

product_lines.name: Silky PLA
product_lines.notes: Standard PLA base with a silk/gloss additive.

product_lines.name: Extreme Impact PLA / Ultra Impact Modified PLA
product_lines.notes: PLA + impact modifier — the toughened/'Tough PLA' category.

product_lines.name: PETG PRO
product_lines.notes: Standard opaque PETG plus Translucent, Neon UV-Reactive, Metallic, Shade-Shifting and Extreme JET Black effect colourways.

product_lines.name: Carbon Fiber Extreme PETG PRO
product_lines.notes: PETG + carbon fibre; Extreme Black plus Dark Cherry, Dark Blue, Stone Gray and Smoke Blue colourways.

product_lines.name: PCTG PRO
product_lines.notes: Glycol-modified copolyester, higher impact than PETG; opaque, translucent/clear, marble, metallic and neon colourways.

product_lines.name: Carbon Fiber Extreme Black PCTG PRO
product_lines.notes: PCTG + carbon fibre. Listed against pctg for family context only — no pctg-cf id exists.

product_lines.name: Carbon Fiber ABS / CARBON FIBER Ultra Black ABS
product_lines.notes: ABS + carbon fibre. Listed against abs for family context only — the catalog has abs-gf but no abs-cf id.

product_lines.name: FLAME RETARDANT Sabic FR15U Black ABS
product_lines.notes: Built on SABIC Cycolac FR15U, a UL94 flame-retardant ABS grade — a named industrial resin rather than a generic FR compound.

product_lines.name: Nuclear Nylon v3
product_lines.notes: Described as an engineering-grade alloyed PA copolymer with adhesion promoters and impact modifiers; exact PA type (6/12/66) undisclosed, so it maps to the generic pa entry rather than pa6/pa12.

product_lines.name: Black Carbon Fiber Nuclear Nylon v3
product_lines.notes: Alloyed PA copolymer + milled carbon fibre. PA type undisclosed, so neither pa6-cf nor pa12-cf can be asserted and no generic pa-cf id exists; listed against pa for family context only.

product_lines.name: 3.5 kg Jumbo rolls (PLA / PETG / ABS / ASA / CF)
product_lines.notes: Bulk-spool packaging of the resins already listed above — not a distinct chemistry.

additional_notes: Corporate entity name beyond the trading name "Atomic Filament" was not confirmed; address of record is 6928 North 400 East, Kendallville, Indiana. Founded 2014 by a founder identified publicly only as "Mike"; privately owned with a hands-on founder-operator model. Sells 3.5 kg jumbo rolls and sample packs. No nylon, PC, TPU, PVA or HIPS lines confirmed. Filament Cheat Sheet rates the brand Tier A. A rumored link to Proto-pasta or 3D Printlife was searched for and returned no corroborating evidence — treat any such claim as unfounded; oem_relationships is therefore empty.

provenance.conflicts: An unsourced community claim linking Atomic Filament to Proto-pasta / 3D Printlife could not be corroborated and is recorded here as rejected rather than encoded as a relationship. Carbon-fiber base polymers are inferred, not documented.
